cleanup.notes: Setup creates the virtual environment .venv in the lab folder (the README creates and activates it before the setup command) and installs the exact versions pinned in starter/requirements.txt, the lab's lock of every installed package. httpx2 is pinned because Starlette 1.10's TestClient prefers it and warns when only httpx is installed; the learner's code and the pages use httpx, as FastAPI's testing tutorial does. The test command writes .pytest_cache and __pycache__ folders; the Task 8 check starts child Python processes with bytecode writing off and the pytest cache plugin disabled. No test opens a socket: TestClient calls the app in-process and an httpx.MockTransport stands in for the Spring Boot workshop catalog, so no Spring service, database or network is needed; the optional uvicorn run listens on 127.0.0.1 only and is stopped with Ctrl-C. The sign-ups come from fixtures/signups.json through the shipped repository; the checks replace it through dependency overrides. Resetting the learner's work means copying the four edited files back from a fresh copy of the lab. The expected output replaces the per-learner test count and the run time with placeholders, because Task 8 adds the learner's own tests to the run. The 45-minute median is a task-by-task authoring estimate of the eight tasks, not a measured learner pilot; 60 minutes is the cap of the 30-60 minute module-lab allowance. The checks observe HTTP status codes and JSON bodies, the settings read from environment variables, the request the client sends and the errors fetch_workshop raises; Task 8 runs the learner's tests against their code and against a broken app and a broken fetch_workshop.
